scope: Processing job recovery driven by existing fenced outbox dispatcher; no media worker activation

implementation.coordination: One lifecycle/claim-owning dispatcher loop calls reconciler before publishing. Decisions publish/defer/terminal avoid two timers competing for due intents. Module exports reconciler for future standalone worker; no API imports it.
implementation.lost_job: Queue.getJob missing reconstructs exact stable job ID/payload with attempts MAX3 minus persisted processing_attempts. Dispatcher never increments/resets processing budget. Real integration removes waiting job, preserves DB attempts2 and recreates with attempts1.
implementation.lease_protection: Repository snapshot locks Video then Outbox, matching finalization order; DB clock verifies live outbox claim after locks. Live processing lease defers without publishing/terminal mutation. Healthy defer clears claim and reschedules without falsely recording delivery or failure. Expired processing lease is reclaimable through existing claimProcessing which replaces token/increments DB budget; old token cannot finalize.
implementation.terminal_jobs: Failed jobs with no active DB lease persist sanitized PROCESSING_FAILED. Completed+DBprocessing is never trusted as ready; retry(completed, resetAttemptsMade:false, resetAttemptsStarted:false) atomically moves only expected completed job back to wait, then idempotent add confirms publication. No remove-by-stable-ID race. Active/unknown jobs defer to avoid disrupting a locked queue job.
implementation.bounded_recovery: Exhausted DB budget closes error without a fourth DB attempt. Completed jobs that repeatedly finish without recording a DB claim also stop at queue attempt limit, preventing an infinite completed-without-persistence loop. Queue counters and DB attempts never reset.
implementation.atomic_failure: VideosRepository.failProcessingRecovery locks Video then Outbox; rejects active DB lease, stale/expired outbox claim and ineligible budget reason. SQL update additionally checks live outbox token/deadline via EXISTS at transition time. Error transition clears stale processing ownership and completeForVideo closes intent in same transaction.
implementation.rollback: Real SQL failure after terminal mutation+outbox completion rolls transaction back together; dispatcher releases/reschedules open claim and next pass completes recovery. DB inspection failures propagate for safe retry.
implementation.privacy: Persist only fixed error code/message and existing sanitized dispatch diagnostic; raw job failedReason/returnvalue, stderr, keys or credentials do not become API/DB recovery data.
implementation.tests: 18 new unit cases and12 new integration cases plus3 new dispatcher unit cases.76 affected tests include prior dispatcher/queue/repository suites. Real test-only BullMQ Workers generate completed and exhausted failed states; they close before cleanup. No production consumer or FFmpeg process is run.
